rows.note: Use 唔 as the all-purpose casual negator before verbs and predicates.

example.english: I do not eat spicy food.

rows.note: Use 不 mainly as a formal or written equivalent of 唔, rather than as the usual casual spoken choice.

example.english: This company does not accept returns.
